text:
Situation: Risperidone 125 mg/0.35 mL syringes are in limited supply at both campuses. Corvale East holds 197 syringes at 5.3 used daily, providing 37.1 days on hand. Corvale General holds 183 syringes at 8 used daily, providing 22.8 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show risperidone is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate at Corvale East but approaching a monitoring threshold at Corvale General. No national shortage is declared.

Recommended actions:
1. Pharmacy buyer to place expedited orders for Corvale General and confirm delivery dates; requires Purchasing Director approval.
2. Pharmacy manager to implement inter-campus transfer of 30 syringes from Corvale East to Corvale General; requires P&T Committee approval.
3. Inventory team to track daily usage at both sites and report weekly to Pharmacy Director; requires Pharmacy Director approval.

Not recommended: No formulary changes, therapeutic substitutions, or allocation restrictions at this time.
